benchmark_metadata.title: Phase 5 Empirical Cybersecurity Evaluation Benchmark
benchmark_metadata.description: Standardized, reproducible benchmark dataset evaluating retrieval recall, answer grounding, multimodal cross-modal corroboration, and hallucination reduction across frozen Phase 1-4 RAG subsystems.
